stem: Meena's mother keeps leftover cooked rice in the refrigerator, but after three days the rice smells sour. Meena's friend says, "Souring of food is always an undesirable change." Using the situation and purpose, which statement is correct?

options.text: Souring of milk is always undesirable, so setting curd from milk at home is also undesirable.
The souring of the leftover rice is undesirable here because the rice was meant to be eaten later and is now spoilt.
The souring of the rice is desirable because every chemical change is useful.
The souring of the rice is neither desirable nor undesirable because a change cannot be judged.

teacher.key_rationale: Desirability is judged by purpose and situation: the rice was stored for eating, so its souring (spoilage) is undesirable — B. A is wrong because souring of milk is desirable when the purpose is making curd. C is wrong because not every chemical change is useful. D is wrong because changes can be judged by usefulness or harm in context.
